{{Main|Equipment}}
'''Sturdy leather armor''' is a stronger leather set crafted from [[Sturdy Leather|sturdy leather]]. It has Projectile Protection, 2 safe fall distance per piece, and the boots add step height and [[Trailblaze]].

== Obtaining ==
The pieces are the [[Sturdy Leather Helmet|helmet]], [[Sturdy Leather Gambeson|gambeson]], [[Sturdy Leather Leggings|leggings]] and [[Sturdy Leather Boots|boots]]. They are repaired with tattered leather.

=== Village tannery chests ===
The [[village]] tannery's loot table can give a piece of sturdy leather armor from an older version of the set, which is invisible when worn and weaker than the crafted pieces.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/village/village_tannery.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/equipment/sturdy_leather.json}}</ref> The pack's [[abandoned village]]s have no loot chests, so the table isn't normally used. [[Shipwreck]] supply chests give the current pieces.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/equipment/sturdy_leather/armour.json}}</ref>

{{Upcoming|the 26.3 port}}
In the 1.12.3 alpha for 26.3, and in the 26.3 port, the tannery's loot table is empty, and no other table rolls the older pieces.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/village/village_tannery.json|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref>
